captions.caption: A driver operates windshield wipers during a heavy rainstorm at night in Saudi Arabia.
Windshield wipers clear rain from a car's front window while driving on a dark street.
A vehicle travels through a rainy night with blurry streetlights visible through the windshield.
Intense rain falls on a city street at night, illuminated by bright overhead lights.
Car headlights shine through heavy downpour on a wet road at night.
A large green cargo truck is stranded in deep floodwaters during a cloudy day.
Brown floodwater surrounds a stationary semi-truck on what used to be a road.
A white truck is partially submerged as floodwaters cover the landscape.
The camera pans across a wide, flooded area with several large vehicles stuck in the water.
A silver sedan is almost entirely underwater due to severe flooding.
Only the top of a submerged car is visible in the deep brown floodwater.
Flooding in Saudi Arabia has left vehicles almost completely covered by water.
A view of a wide flooded plain where buildings and cars are impacted by high water levels.
Brown water flows through an urban area, submerging cars up to their roofs.
An expansive area is covered in floodwater under a grey, overcast sky.
Water rushes over a paved road surface during a flood event in Saudi Arabia.
A truck maneuvers through shallow water on a flooded roadway.
The camera shows the extent of the flooding across a flat, urbanized landscape.
Fierce orange flames and thick smoke rise from a wildfire at night in the USA.
A massive wildfire burns intensely through trees, creating a bright orange glow.
Flames consume vegetation and light up the dark night sky during a forest fire.
Strong winds fanned a massive fire in Southern California, showing raging flames.
Glowing embers fly through the air as the wildfire spreads across the hills.
A hillside is completely engulfed in bright orange fire at night.
The night sky is filled with smoke and the intense light of the wildfire.
A vehicle drives along a road surrounded by walls of fire on both sides.
The car's dashboard is seen as it navigates through a hazardous area with fire nearby.
Bright orange fire lines the edges of a highway as a vehicle drives through.
Thick smoke and intense heat are visible from the perspective of a car in the fire zone.
Flames reach high into the air alongside a road during a Southern California wildfire.
A car continues its journey through a hazy and fire-stricken landscape.
The scene shows an apocalyptic view of fire and smoke from the front of a moving car.
A hillside burns with bright yellow and orange flames during the daytime.
Intense fire consumes dry brush on a slope, generating thick smoke.
Large clouds of brown and yellow smoke billow from a brush fire.
Fire spreads across a grassy area, with flames visible against the sky.
A wide view of the wildfire shows flames moving across the terrain.
Thick smoke obscures the sky as the fire continues to burn through vegetation.
The camera pans across the smoky landscape of an active wildfire.
A firefighting helicopter drops a large amount of water onto a burning area near a road.
The helicopter flies low, releasing water to suppress the flames of a wildfire.
A large firefighting aircraft releases a stream of water over a smoke-filled area.
The aircraft moves through the air after completing a water drop on the fire.
A helicopter maneuvers over the fire zone, releasing water to help put out the blaze.
The sun appears as a pale disc through the thick haze of wildfire smoke.
The sky is heavily clouded with smoke from the ongoing California wildfire.
A large dust-filled tornado swirls across a desert landscape in Saudi Arabia.
The tall column of rotating dust and sand moves across the open ground.
Debris is lifted high into the air by the powerful vortex of a dust devil.
A massive tornado in El Jauf, Saudi Arabia, is seen from a distance across the desert.
The camera focuses on the base of the swirling dust column on the desert floor.
Thick brown dust is whipped into a funnel shape by strong winds.
The dust tornado continues its rapid rotation in the middle of a barren area.
A wide shot shows the scale of the dust storm and the central tornado column.
The base of the tornado churns up sand and debris as it moves.
The tornado moves across the desert, creating a large cloud of dust.
The sky is filled with dust, making visibility poor around the tornado.
Debris circulates within the powerful winds of the dust vortex.
The funnel cloud stands tall against the horizon in a desert region.
Swirling dust and sand dominate the view in this footage of a Saudi Arabian tornado.
